Pitch Black 2 Encounters

A fun aspect of Nuzlocke runs is the variety of encounters forcing you to try out new Pokémon you've never used before. That is why it's important to know which Pokémon will be available during a run. We've compiled a list of every encounter for Pokémon Pitch Black 2 so you can quickly see who you might want on your team!

Pokémon Pitch Black 2 has 75 different encounter locations with 443 different Pokémon available as wild encounters. Hover over a Pokémon to see where to encounter it!

Pitch Black 2 Boss Battles

In order to complete a Pitch Black 2 Nuzlocke and become the Champion, you will need to win 366 Boss battles throughout the Unova region - ranging from bickering Rival & Evil team fights, to Gym Leaders & ultimately the Elite Four.

These can be a challenge, especially when your dear nicknamed nuzlocke mons are at risk. So below we've listed detailed overviews of all these fights! Giving you all the information you'll need to face everything from ↕️ Rival MiMsu's Pignite to Elite Four Marshal's Lucario.

16 Gym Leader fights

5 Elite Four fights

14 Rival fights

45 Evil Team fights

7 Mini Boss fights

279 Other fights

Select your starter type

Like all Pokémon games, you will have to select a starter. The type will update some of the boss teams to match. For example, if your starter was a grass type ↕️ Rival MiMsu might have a fire type to take advantage!
